notes.title: 20250804 Patch Notes - small geometry & lighting updates
notes.notes:
Nothing crazy, it's just tiny stuff that makes me like the game that much more :)

Zero fades out a little more cleanly
Zero's sfx fade out a little bit more

The Temple geometry overlaps less in places
Another object got the same treatment

(those things make a certain effect look more clean)

Lighting/shadows for some objects was popping in/out at some angles & distances, I think that's all better now

Have fun!

notes.title: DX11 hotfix
notes.notes: Bugfix - In some situations DX11 support was not activating

notes.title: 20250804 Patch Notes - French localization is now available
notes.notes: [p]French is available in the public build, thanks for testing :) There are a couple other changes that should improve performance for some players. Finally a few pieces of geometry were moved ever so slightly, so some animations are cleaner. [/p]

notes.title: hotfix - sfx
notes.notes: The last patch disabled SFX accidentally. They're back now, so sorry!

notes.title: 20241231 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Features
-Discord Rich Presence

Bugs:
-made one object lighter so it can't bounce the player
-small adjustment to light gate hitbox
-CVD overlay now describes the color of the light bridge object
-waterslide achievement could be triggred by very exotic event
-[spoiler]unwinnable bet now even more unwinnable[/spoiler]
-[spoiler]post-game, after using dark-switch, you can now restore a color (again) to trigger the Blue (light mix) music track[/spoiler]

Text:
-capitalized 'Wall' once
-new text for [spoiler]extra-unwinnable bet[/spoiler]

notes.title: 20241219 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
features:
-1280x800 to resolution added as the last option of the resolution options (for Steam Deck)
-music continues to play during pause menu

gameplay:
-[spoiler]a very important zero auto-clicks itself now[/spoiler]

bugs:
-destroying something with CVD long-text-description now also removes the text
-there is now practically no chance of running over a broken light bridge, even at capped/slow fps
-ultrawide letterbox goes 5000px wide, hopefully that's enough
-waterslide won't activate if you're falling from magenta (nor will the achievement)
-can't activate waterslide achievement from the bottom pool
-fixed an invalid object situation throwing editor errors mostly
-minimum window size enforced at 320 x 240, hi arcade peeps
-couple sfx would play during pause menu, fixed

text:
-2 playtester names
-[spoiler]void zero more properly implies that you have an action to take[/spoiler]
-[spoiler]comma by the zero near the sanctuary/pool is now a period[/spoiler]

speedrun:
-return to title button is 2.2x faster
-achievement is awarded even if you're using... [spoiler]a certain tactic[/spoiler]


TBD:
-menu has keyboard focus issues, sometimes you need to use a mouse to click "return" instead of esc working always (especially after alt-tabbing)
-considering ways to allow pause menu/restart during cutscenes for speedruns
-considering discord rich presence implementation
